product_metadata.title: Glotoch 2-Tier Full Sized Dish Drying Rack with Utensil Holder and Cup Holder with Dish Water Drain Board Tray Rustproof Chrome Plating 16.5 x 10 x 15 Inches Storage Space Saving Kitchen Organizer
features: 2 Tier Dish Rack - Elegantly designed to match any home decor and help organize your kitchen. Perfect for drying dishes after washing them, relax by letting them air dry! Holds a surprisingly large amount of up to tableware from cutlery to cups to dishes and bowls!

High Quality Materials - Our enhanced product quality is sure to satisfy and provide an organization solution for years to come! The water catching drip tray is made with only non-leeching plastics to ensure your tableware dries safely.

Coated with Chrome - Sturdy stainless steel plated with a rust resistant chrome coating to ensure anti-scratch and anti-spotting properties. The chromium plating on our dish drying rack is provided to guarantee durability and to help maintain the appearance and finish.

Large Size Dish Drying Rack - This large dish drying rack has a capacity holding up to 11 plates, 18 bowls, 6 glasses and up to 15 pieces of silverware simultaneously. Even comes with an extra side mounted cup holder and utensil holder to ensure all your tableware has room!

Easy Setup and Installation - Comes with all hardware for mounting and set up, follow the instructions included to assemble the dish rack. Compact enough to fit on your counter top while large enough to hold all your dishes and silverware!
